title: Choosing a color from the shift modal's picker recolors the shift with matching background, text, and accent tones
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. A shift exists; its detail modal is open.
steps: 1. Open the color picker in the modal.
3. Look at the block on the grid.
expected: 1. The shift's block re-renders in the chosen color.
2. The color provides three consistent tones: background fill, text color, and accent (left border).
3. Colors carry no fixed meaning - they are free choice beyond the two defaults (blue shift / grey event).
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
